0022600184.text: The Dallas Mavericks (4-2, 7th in the West, on a three-game winning streak) visit the San Antonio Spurs (4-2, 5th in the West, on a four-game winning streak) in a matchup of teams with identical records as of today. Dallas is missing Kyrie Irving (knee), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), while San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The Mavericks trail the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after a 122-106 loss in Dallas on October 24, and they lost the 2025-26 series 0-4.
